title: Replacement pieces are not available
text: Replacement pieces are not available. While I like the compost bin, the company itself needs an overhaul. The green piece that holds the filter in place went missing, and I contacted the company to see about getting a replacement plastic piece. Turns out I can’t get a new plastic piece, but I can buy a whole new unit or get a replacement sent to me if still under warranty. Wasteful and unnecessary.

product_metadata.title: Chef'n EcoCrock Countertop Compost Bin
features: REUSABLE CHARCOAL FILTER: The EcoCrock kitchen compost bin features a reusable filter in the lid. No need to buy replacement filters! Simply hand washing the removable lid will clean the activated charcoal filter for continued use.

CARRY AND OPEN WITH ONE HAND: This composting bin makes carrying and dumping food waste outside easy while minimizing the mess. The handle is comfortable and secure, and the lid can be flipped open with one thumb.
ODOR FREE: The compost bin lid’s activated charcoal filter traps and absorbs odors keeping your kitchen smelling fresh and clean.

COUNTERTOP OR UNDER THE SINK: This thoughtfully designed home compost bin has a capacity of 3.4 quarts and can be used with or without a bag. It is ideal for storing under the sink or on the kitchen counter.
EASY TO CLEAN: All pieces are top-rack dishwasher safe. To extend the lifetime of the filter, hand wash the lid.
description: It’s time to get scrappy! Did you know that collecting fruit and vegetable scraps in a food waste compost bin and composting them is an incredibly easy way to give back to the environment and reduce your carbon footprint? And, it's made even more convenient with our latest Compost Bin. You can carry, open, and empty with just one hand and the removable lid includes a reusable charcoal filter so you can say goodbye to buying replacement filters. Happy composting! Chef’n designs fun and innovative gadgets to encourage exploration in the kitchen, and make pesky cooking tasks more enjoyable. Clever cooking and happy kitchens with Chef’n!
